title: GAMBET
tagline: Decentralized sports prediction platform with AI-powered betting events on Chiliz Chain
description:
Gambet revolutionizes the traditional, boring betting experience by introducing a visually stunning social media-style feed where users can discover, create, and participate in prediction markets through natural language conversations with an AI agent. This innovative platform transforms betting from a mundane activity into an engaging, visual experience that combines the power of blockchain technology, artificial intelligence, and community creativity.
The core innovation lies in the conversational AI interface and visual representation - users can simply chat with an intelligent agent in natural language to discover new betting opportunities or create entirely new prediction events. Instead of navigating complex forms with dropdowns and selectors, users describe their predictions in plain language, and the AI automatically generates a structured betting event with appropriate odds, categories, and most importantly, a custom AI-generated image that visually represents the prediction.
These AI-generated images are the heart of the platform's visual appeal - each prediction event is displayed as a beautiful, representative image in the social feed, making browsing through betting opportunities as engaging as scrolling through Instagram or Pinterest. When users place successful bets, these images are converted into unique NFT collectibles, serving as permanent digital memories of their successful predictions.
Built on the Chiliz blockchain, Gambet features a social feed interface where users can browse through "Visions" - community-created prediction events that range from sports outcomes to entertainment predictions. Each Vision is represented by its AI-generated image, creating an immersive visual experience that makes betting discovery intuitive and enjoyable.
The platform introduces a revolutionary creator economy: when a user's Vision is used by others for betting and those bets win, the original creator receives rewards in the form of "Vision" tokens. This incentivizes users to create high-quality, engaging prediction events and builds a community where creators are rewarded for their contributions.
how_its_made:
Frontend Architecture:
React 18 + TypeScript: Modern React with strict typing for robust development
Vite: Fast build tool for rapid development and optimized production builds
Tailwind CSS: Utility-first CSS framework for responsive, modern UI design
Radix UI: Accessible, unstyled UI components for consistent design system
Wagmi + Viem: Ethereum wallet integration and blockchain interaction libraries
Backend Infrastructure:
Node.js + Express: RESTful API server with middleware for CORS and authentication
PostgreSQL (Neon): Cloud-native database for storing visions, user data, and betting information
JWT Authentication: Secure token-based authentication system
Blockchain Integration:
Solidity Smart Contracts: Custom contracts for bet management and NFT minting
Chiliz Chain: Sports-focused blockchain with native CHZ token support
Foundry: Development framework for smart contract testing and deployment
OpenZeppelin: Battle-tested smart contract libraries for security
AI Features:
OpenAI Integration: GPT-powered AI agent for generating betting events and user interaction
DALL-E Integration: AI-generated images for betting events
Conversational Interface: Natural language processing for event creation
